full_name: Ha-yun Jung | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Ha-yun Jung has published short stories in Prairie Schooner, The Threepenny Review, and the anthology Best New American Voices 2001, edited by Charles Baxter, among other publications.
